quotations.old_english: Heora án his exe úp ábrǽd, wolde hine sleán, ac him forwyrnde sum óþer, swá þ-bar; hé þ-bar; hylfe gelǽhte and wiðhæfde þ-bar; slege (held back the pole of the axe) þone slege the stroke, might have been expected)

source_text: slege, es; n. Add: the handle of an axe (?) :-- Heora án his exe úp ábrǽd, wolde hine sleán, ac him forwyrnde sum óþer, swá þ-bar; hé þ-bar; hylfe gelǽhte and wiðhæfde þ-bar; slege (held back the pole of the axe) þone slege the stroke, might have been expected), Hml. S. 31, 154.
